text:
emily: :rotating_light: getting a pile of customer reports — hosted /v1/generate returning 503s and timeouts since the hotpatch deploy a few minutes ago. Rolling incident, alerting eng and support.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: commit a1b2c3 -> prod/hosted at 2025-11-12T11:43:20Z (1758520000).

sanjay: oncall here, jumping in. Any config flips tied to this deploy? Alerts show spike starting at 11:43 UTC.

maria: I see gateway 502/503s correlated with auth service errors — several traces missing X-Auth-Provider header. Example trace id abc123, upstream returned "no compatible model found". Logs attached to trace.

emily: we did flip a new fallback_policy: "prefer-assistant" during the rollout. If the selector path doesn't match model variants the runtime returns 503 instead of a graceful fallback. Could be a selector mismatch.

ryan: quick repro: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` sometimes gets 503 and the log shows `error="no_compatible_model"`. Also seeing increased retries from client side causing billing churn.

support-bot: support queue flagged 27 tickets referencing 503/timeouts in the last 15m. Some customers hit repeated retries and billing alerts fired (retry amplification). CS standing by.

sanjay: ok, we need a coordinated rollback of the fallback_policy flip. Who can flip it back and on what scope? We want to seed rollback at 1% then monitor. Avoid a full immediate rollback without telemetry sync.

maria: I'm rolling the flag back to `fallback_policy=default` for seed=1% now (patching the rollout config). I'll post updates — if stable we'll ramp to 100% over 10m.

emily: if the rollback doesn't fully clear the wave, prepare to shift traffic to dedicated pools for affected tenants (manual route-cut). Also notify billing ops to hold any automated chargeback until we confirm retry storms resolved.

ryan: metrics update: after 1% rollback error rate dropped from ~6% to ~0.8% within 3 minutes for the slice. Latency also trending down. Holding on ramp.

emily: :thumbsup: good catch everyone. Emily -> pinging CS + billing ops with a short customer-facing note. Follow-up action: postmortem to include why the fallback selector path wasn't validated in smoke tests and add a guard in rollout job to block fallback flips without selector compatibility checks.
